pokemon.pokedexEntry: It loves to snooze on bitterly cold ice. The sight of this POKéMON sleeping on a glacier was mistakenly thought to be a mermaid by a mariner long ago.

pokemon.name: MUK
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It prefers warm and humid habitats. In the summertime, the toxic substances in its body intensify, making MUK reek like putrid kitchen garbage.

pokemon.name: SHELLDER
pokemon.pokedexEntry: At night, it burrows a hole in the seafloor with its broad tongue to make a place to sleep. While asleep, it closes its shell, but leaves its tongue hanging out.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: CLOYSTER
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It swims in the sea by swallowing water, then jetting it out toward the rear. The CLOYSTER shoots spikes from its shell using the same system.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: GASTLY
pokemon.pokedexEntry: When exposed to a strong wind, a GASTLY's gaseous body quickly dwindles away. They cluster under the eaves of houses to escape the ravages of wind.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: HAUNTER
pokemon.pokedexEntry: If a HAUNTER beckons you while it is floating in darkness, don't approach it. This POKéMON will try to lick you with its tongue and steal your life away.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: GENGAR
pokemon.pokedexEntry: Deep in the night, your shadow cast by a streetlight may suddenly overtake you. It is actually a GENGAR running past you, pretending to be your shadow.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: ONIX
pokemon.pokedexEntry: There is a magnet in its brain that prevents an ONIX from losing direction while tunneling. As it grows older, its body becomes steadily rounder and smoother.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: DROWZEE
pokemon.pokedexEntry: If your nose becomes itchy while you are sleeping, it's a sure sign that a DROWZEE is standing above your pillow and trying to eat your dream through your nostrils.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: HYPNO
pokemon.pokedexEntry: The arcing movement and glitter of the pendulum in a HYPNO's hand lull the foe into deep hypnosis. While searching for prey, it polishes the pendulum.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: KRABBY
pokemon.pokedexEntry: KRABBY live in holes dug into beaches. On sandy shores with little in the way of food, they can be seen squabbling with each other over territory.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: KINGLER
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It waves its huge, oversized claw in the air to communicate with others. But since the claw is so heavy, this POKéMON quickly tires.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: VOLTORB
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It bears an uncanny and unexplained resemblance to a POKé BALL. Because it explodes at the slightest shock, even veteran TRAINERS treat it with caution.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: ELECTRODE
pokemon.pokedexEntry: They appear in great numbers at electric power plants. Because they feed on electricity, they cause massive and chaotic blackouts in nearby cities.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: EXEGGCUTE
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It consists of six eggs that care for each other. The eggs attract each other and spin around. When cracks increasingly appear, it is close to evolution.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: EXEGGUTOR
pokemon.pokedexEntry: Originally from the tropics, EXEGGUTOR's heads grow larger from exposure to strong sunlight. It is said that when the heads fall, they group to form an EXEGGCUTE.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: CUBONE
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It pines for the mother it will never see again. Seeing a likeness of its mother in the full moon, it cries. The stains on the skull it wears are from its tears.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: MAROWAK
pokemon.pokedexEntry: A MAROWAK is the evolved form of a CUBONE that has grown tough by overcoming the grief of losing its mother. Its tempered and hardened spirit is not easily broken.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: HITMONLEE
pokemon.pokedexEntry: Its legs freely stretch and contract. Using these springlike limbs, it bowls over foes with devastating kicks. After battle, it rubs down its tired legs.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: HITMONCHAN
pokemon.pokedexEntry: A HITMONCHAN is said to possess the spirit of a boxer who aimed to become the world champion. Having an indomitable spirit means that it will never give up.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: LICKITUNG
pokemon.pokedexEntry: Whenever it sees something unfamiliar, it always licks the object because it memorizes things by texture and taste. It is somewhat put off by sour things.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: KOFFING
pokemon.pokedexEntry: Getting up close to a KOFFING will give you a chance to observe, through its thin skin, the toxic gases swirling inside. It blows up at the slightest stimulation.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: WEEZING
pokemon.pokedexEntry: By diluting its toxic gases with a special process, the highest grade of perfume can be extracted. To WEEZING, gases emanating from garbage are the ultimate feast.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: RHYHORN
pokemon.pokedexEntry: Once it starts running, it doesn't stop. Its tiny brain makes it so stupid that it can't remember why it started running in the first place.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: RHYDON
pokemon.pokedexEntry: Its horn, which rotates like a drill, destroys tall buildings with one strike. It stands on its hind legs, and its brain is well developed.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: CHANSEY
pokemon.pokedexEntry: CHANSEY lay nutritionally excellent eggs every day. The eggs are so delicious, they are eagerly devoured by even those people who have lost their appetite.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: TANGELA
pokemon.pokedexEntry: Its vines snap off easily and painlessly if they are grabbed, allowing it to make a quick getaway. The lost vines are replaced by new growth the very next day.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: KANGASKHAN
pokemon.pokedexEntry: If you come across a young KANGASKHAN playing by itself, never try to catch it. The baby's parent is sure to be in the area, and it will become violently enraged.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: HORSEA
pokemon.pokedexEntry: By cleverly flicking the fins on its back side to side, it moves in any direction while facing forward. It spits ink to escape if it senses danger.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: SEADRA
pokemon.pokedexEntry: The poisonous barbs all over its body are highly valued as ingredients for making traditional herbal medicine. It shows no mercy to anything approaching its nest.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: GOLDEEN
pokemon.pokedexEntry: In the springtime, schools of GOLDEEN can be seen swimming up falls and rivers. It metes out staggering damage with its single horn.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: SEAKING
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It punches holes in boulders on stream- beds. This is a clever innovation that prevents its eggs from being attacked or washed away by the current.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: STARYU
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It gathers with others in the night and makes its red core glow on and off with the twinkling stars. It can regenerate limbs if they are severed from its body.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: STARMIE
pokemon.pokedexEntry: People in ancient times imagined that STARMIE were transformed from the reflections of stars that twinkled on gentle waves at night.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: MR. MIME
pokemon.pokedexEntry: A MR. MIME is a master of pantomime. It can convince others that something unseeable actually exists. Once believed, the imaginary object does become real.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: SCYTHER
pokemon.pokedexEntry: Its blindingly fast speed adds to the sharpness of its twin forearm scythes. The scythes can slice through thick logs in one wicked stroke.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: JYNX
pokemon.pokedexEntry: A JYNX sashays rhythmically as if it were dancing. Its motions are so bouncingly alluring, people seeing it are compelled to shake their hips without noticing.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: ELECTABUZZ
pokemon.pokedexEntry: When a storm approaches, it competes with others to scale heights that are likely to be stricken by lightning. Some towns use ELECTABUZZ in place of lightning rods.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: MAGMAR
pokemon.pokedexEntry: In battle, it blows out intense flames from all over its body to intimidate its foe. These fiery bursts create heat waves that ignite grass and trees in the area.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: PINSIR
pokemon.pokedexEntry: Their pincers are strong enough to shatter thick logs. Because they dislike cold, PINSIR burrow and sleep under the ground on chilly nights.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: TAUROS
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It is not satisfied unless it is rampaging at all times. If there is no opponent for TAUROS to battle, it will charge at thick trees and knock them down to calm itself.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: MAGIKARP
pokemon.pokedexEntry: Its swimming muscles are weak, so it is easily washed away by currents. In places where water pools, you can see many MAGIKARP deposited there by the flow.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: GYARADOS
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It is an extremely vicious and violent POKéMON. When humans begin to fight, it will appear and burn everything to the ground with intensely hot flames.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: LAPRAS
pokemon.pokedexEntry: People have driven LAPRAS almost to the point of extinction. In the evenings, it is said to sing plaintively as it seeks what few others of its kind still remain.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: DITTO
pokemon.pokedexEntry: A DITTO rearranges its cell structure to transform itself. However, if it tries to change based on its memory, it will get details wrong.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: EEVEE
pokemon.pokedexEntry: An EEVEE has an unstable genetic makeup that suddenly mutates due to its environment. Radiation from various STONES causes this POKéMON to evolve.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: VAPOREON
pokemon.pokedexEntry: VAPOREON underwent a spontaneous mutation and grew fins and gills that allow them to live underwater. They have the ability to freely control water.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: JOLTEON
pokemon.pokedexEntry: Its cells generate weak power that is amplified by its fur's static electricity to drop thunderbolts. The bristling fur is made of electrically charged needles.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: FLAREON
pokemon.pokedexEntry: FLAREON's fluffy fur releases heat into the air so that its body does not get excessively hot. Its body temperature can rise to a maximum of 1,650 degrees F.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: PORYGON
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It is capable of reverting itself entirely back to program data in order to enter cyberspace. A PORYGON is copy- protected so it cannot be duplicated.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: OMANYTE
pokemon.pokedexEntry: One of the ancient and long-since-extinct POKéMON that have been regenerated from fossils by humans. If attacked, it withdraws into its hard shell.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: OMASTAR
pokemon.pokedexEntry: An OMASTAR uses its tentacles to capture its prey. It is believed to have become extinct because its shell grew too large, making its movements slow and ponderous.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: KABUTO
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It is a POKéMON that has been regenerated from a fossil. However, in rare cases, living examples have been discovered. KABUTO have not changed for 300 million years.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: KABUTOPS
pokemon.pokedexEntry: KABUTOPS once swam underwater to hunt for prey. It was apparently evolving from being a water dweller to living on land as evident from changes in its gills and legs.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: AERODACTYL
pokemon.pokedexEntry: AERODACTYL is a POKéMON from the age of dinosaurs. It was regenerated from DNA extracted from amber. It is imagined to have been the king of the skies.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: SNORLAX
pokemon.pokedexEntry: SNORLAX's typical day consists of nothing more than eating and sleeping. It is such a docile POKéMON that there are children who use its big belly as a place to play.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: ARTICUNO
pokemon.pokedexEntry: ARTICUNO is a legendary bird POKéMON that can control ice. The flapping of its wings chills the air. As a result, it is said that when this POKéMON flies, snow will fall.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: ZAPDOS
pokemon.pokedexEntry: ZAPDOS is a legendary bird POKéMON that has the ability to control electricity. It usually lives in thunderclouds. It gains power if it is stricken by lightning bolts.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: MOLTRES
pokemon.pokedexEntry: MOLTRES is a legendary bird POKéMON that can control fire. If injured, it is said to dip its body in the molten magma of a volcano to burn and heal itself.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: DRATINI
pokemon.pokedexEntry: A DRATINI continually molts and sloughs off its old skin. It does so because the life energy within its body steadily builds to reach uncontrollable levels.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: DRAGONAIR
pokemon.pokedexEntry: A DRAGONAIR stores an enormous amount of energy inside its body. It is said to alter the weather around it by loosing energy from the crystals on its neck and tail.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: DRAGONITE
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It can circle the globe in just 16 hours. It is a kindhearted POKéMON that leads lost and foundering ships in a storm to the safety of land.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: MEWTWO
pokemon.pokedexEntry: A POKéMON that was created by genetic manipulation. However, even though the scientific power of humans made its body, they failed to give it a warm heart.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: MEW
pokemon.pokedexEntry: A MEW is said to possess the genes of all POKéMON. It is capable of making itself invisible at will, so it entirely avoids notice even if it approaches people.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: CHIKORITA
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It waves its leaf around to keep foes at bay. However, a sweet fragrance also wafts from the leaf, creating a friendly atmosphere that becalms the battlers.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: BAYLEEF
pokemon.pokedexEntry: A BAYLEEF's neck is ringed by curled-up leaves. Inside each leaf is a small tree shoot. The fragrance of this shoot makes people peppy.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: MEGANIUM
pokemon.pokedexEntry: The fragrance of a MEGANIUM's flower soothes and calms emotions. In battle, it gives off more of its becalming scent to blunt the foe's fighting spirit.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: CYNDAQUIL
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It flares flames from its back to protect itself. The fire burns vigorously if the POKéMON is angry. When it is tired, it sputters with incomplete combustion.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: QUILAVA
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It intimidates foes with intense gusts of flames and superheated air. Its quick nimbleness lets it dodge attacks even while scorching an enemy.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: TYPHLOSION
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It can hide behind a shimmering heat haze that it creates using its intense flames. TYPHLOSION create blazing explosive blasts that burn everything to cinders.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: TOTODILE
pokemon.pokedexEntry: Despite its small body, TOTODILE's jaws are very powerful. While it may think it is just playfully nipping, its bite has enough strength to cause serious injury.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: CROCONAW
pokemon.pokedexEntry: Once its jaws clamp down on its foe, it will absolutely not let go. Because the tips of its fangs are forked back like fishhooks, they become irremovably embedded.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: FERALIGATR
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It opens its huge mouth to intimidate enemies. In battle, it runs using its thick and powerful hind legs to charge the foe with incredible speed.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: SENTRET
pokemon.pokedexEntry: They take turns standing guard when it is time to sleep. The sentry awakens the others if it senses danger. If one becomes separated, it turns sleepless with fear.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: FURRET
pokemon.pokedexEntry: A FURRET has a very slim build. When under attack, it can squirm through narrow spaces and get away. In spite of its short limbs, it is very nimble and fleet.

pokemon.name: HOOTHOOT
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It has an internal organ that senses the earth's rotation. Using this special organ, a HOOTHOOT begins hooting at precisely the same time every day.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: NOCTOWL
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It unfailingly catches prey in darkness. NOCTOWL owe their success to superior vision that allows them to see in minimal light, and to their supple and silent wings.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: LEDYBA
pokemon.pokedexEntry: LEDYBA communicate using a fluid that they secrete from where the legs join the body. They are said to convey feelings to others by altering the fluid's scent.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: LEDIAN
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It is said that in lands with clean air, where the stars fill the sky, there live many LEDIAN. For good reason, they use the light of the stars as energy.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: SPINARAK
pokemon.pokedexEntry: The web it spins can be considered its second nervous system. It is said that a SPINARAK determines its prey by the tiny vibrations it feels through the web.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: ARIADOS
pokemon.pokedexEntry: Its feet are tipped with tiny hooked claws that enable it to scuttle on ceilings and vertical walls. It constricts its foe with thin and strong silk webbing.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: CROBAT
pokemon.pokedexEntry: Over the course of evolution, its hind legs turned into wings. By alternately resting its front and rear wings, it can fly all day without having to stop.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: CHINCHOU
pokemon.pokedexEntry: When it senses danger, it discharges positive and negative electricity from its two antennae. It lives in depths beyond sunlight's reach.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: LANTURN
pokemon.pokedexEntry: The light-emitting orbs on its back are very bright. They are formed from a part of its dorsal fin. This POKéMON illuminates the inky darkness of deep seas.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: PICHU
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It is still inept at retaining electricity. When it is startled, it discharges power accidentally. It gets better at holding power as it grows older.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: CLEFFA
pokemon.pokedexEntry: On nights with many shooting stars, CLEFFA can be seen dancing in a ring. They dance until daybreak, when they quench their thirst with the morning dew.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: IGGLYBUFF
pokemon.pokedexEntry: Its soft and pliable body is very bouncy. When it sings continuously with all its might, its body steadily turns a deepening pink color.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: TOGEPI
pokemon.pokedexEntry: As its energy, it uses the feelings of compassion and pleasure exuded by people and POKéMON. It stores up happy feelings in its shell, then shares them out.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: TOGETIC
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It is said to be a POKéMON that brings good fortune. When it spots someone who is pure of heart, a TOGETIC appears and shares its happiness with that person.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: NATU
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It runs up short trees that grow on the savanna to peck at new shoots. A NATU's eyes look as if they are always observing something.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: XATU
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It has the enigmatic power of foreseeing the future. Some people in different lands have long believed that XATU are emissaries from another world.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: MAREEP
pokemon.pokedexEntry: Its fluffy wool rubs together and builds a static charge. The more energy is charged, the more brightly the lightbulb at the tip of its tail glows.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: FLAAFFY
pokemon.pokedexEntry: Its fleece quality changes to generate strong static electricity with a small amount of wool. The bare, slick parts of its hide are shielded against electricity.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: AMPHAROS
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It gives off so much light that it can be seen even from space. People in the old days used its light to send signals back and forth with others far away.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: BELLOSSOM
pokemon.pokedexEntry: Its flower petals deepen in color through exposure to sunlight. When cloudy weather persists, it does a dance that is thought to be a ritual for summoning the sun.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: MARILL
pokemon.pokedexEntry: Its body is covered with water-repellent fur. Because of the fur, it can swim through water at high speed without being slowed by the water's resistance.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: AZUMARILL
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It lives in water virtually all day long. Its body color and pattern act as camouflage that makes it tough for enemies to spot in water.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: SUDOWOODO
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It mimics a tree to avoid being attacked by enemies. But since its forelegs remain green throughout the year, it is easily identified as a fake in the winter.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: POLITOED
pokemon.pokedexEntry: The curled hair on its head proves its status as a king. It is said that the longer and curlier the hair, the more respect it earns from its peers.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: HOPPIP
pokemon.pokedexEntry: This POKéMON drifts and floats with the wind. If it senses the approach of strong winds, a HOPPIP links leaves with others to prepare against being blown away.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: SKIPLOOM
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It blossoms when the temperature rises above 64 degrees F. Because its flower's blooming changes with the temperature, it is sometimes used as a thermometer.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: JUMPLUFF
pokemon.pokedexEntry: JUMPLUFF ride warm southern winds to cross the sea and fly to foreign lands. This POKéMON lands when it encounters cold air while it is floating.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: AIPOM
pokemon.pokedexEntry: Its tail ends with a dexterous, handlike appendage. However, because it uses the tail so much, AIPOM's real hands have become rather clumsy.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: SUNKERN
pokemon.pokedexEntry: SUNKERN try to minimize movement to conserve the nutrients they have stored in their bodies for evolution. They will not eat, subsisting only on morning dew.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: SUNFLORA
pokemon.pokedexEntry: SUNFLORA convert solar energy into nutrition. They are highly active in the warm daytime but suddenly stop moving as soon as the sun sets.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: YANMA
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It can see 360 degrees without moving its eyes. It is a great flier capable of making sudden stops and turning midair to quickly chase down targeted prey.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: WOOPER
pokemon.pokedexEntry: WOOPER usually live in water but come out onto land seeking food occasionally. On land, they coat their bodies with a gooey, toxic film.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: QUAGSIRE
pokemon.pokedexEntry: A QUAGSIRE hunts by leaving its mouth wide open in water and waiting for its prey to blunder in. Because it doesn't move, it does not get very hungry.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: ESPEON
pokemon.pokedexEntry: An ESPEON is extremely loyal to any TRAINER it considers to be worthy. It is said to have developed precognitive powers to protect its TRAINER from harm.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: UMBREON
pokemon.pokedexEntry: UMBREON evolved from exposure to the moon's energy pulses. It lurks in darkness and waits for its foes to move. The rings on its body glow when it leaps to attack.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: MURKROW
pokemon.pokedexEntry: MURKROW were feared as the alleged bearers of ill fortune. It shows strong interest in anything that sparkles. It will even try to steal rings from women.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: SLOWKING
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It undertakes research every day to solve the mysteries of the world. However, it apparently forgets everything if the SHELLDER on its head comes off.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: MISDREAVUS
pokemon.pokedexEntry: A MISDREAVUS frightens people with a creepy, sobbing cry. It apparently uses its red spheres to absorb the fear of foes as its nutrition.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: UNOWN
pokemon.pokedexEntry: This POKéMON is shaped like ancient text characters. Although research is ongoing, it is a mystery as to which came first, the ancient writings or the various UNOWN.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: WOBBUFFET
pokemon.pokedexEntry: Usually docile, a WOBBUFFET strikes back ferociously if its black tail is attacked. It makes its lair in caves where it waits for nightfall.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: GIRAFARIG
pokemon.pokedexEntry: A GIRAFARIG is an herbivore--it eats grass and tree shoots. While it is eating, its tail makes chewing and swallowing motions as if it were also eating.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: PINECO
pokemon.pokedexEntry: A PINECO hangs from a tree branch and waits for prey. While eating, if it is disturbed by someone shaking its tree, it falls on the ground and suddenly explodes.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: FORRETRESS
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It keeps itself inside its steel shell. The shell is opened when it is catching prey, but it is so quick that the shell's inside cannot be seen.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: DUNSPARCE
pokemon.pokedexEntry: Its drill-tipped tail is used to burrow into the ground backwards. This POKéMON is known to make its nest in complex shapes deep under the ground.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: GLIGAR
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It glides without making a single sound. It grasps the face of its foe using its hind and large front claws, then stabs with its poison barb.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: STEELIX
pokemon.pokedexEntry: STEELIX live even further underground than ONIX. This POKéMON is known to dig toward the earth's core, reaching a depth of over six-tenths of a mile underground.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: SNUBBULL
pokemon.pokedexEntry: By baring its fangs and making a scary face, it sends smaller POKéMON scurrying in terror. The SNUBBULL does seem a little sad at making its foes flee.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: GRANBULL
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It has a particularly well-developed lower jaw. The huge fangs are heavy, causing it to tilt its head. Unless it is startled, it will not try to bite.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: QWILFISH
pokemon.pokedexEntry: A QWILFISH uses the pressure of water it swallows to shoot toxic quills all at once from all over its body. It finds swimming to be somewhat challenging.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: SCIZOR
pokemon.pokedexEntry: A SCIZOR has a body with the hardness of steel. It is not easily fazed by ordinary sorts of attacks. It flaps its wings to regulate its body temperature.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: SHUCKLE
pokemon.pokedexEntry: A SHUCKLE hides under rocks, keeping its body concealed inside its shell while eating stored berries. The berries mix with its body fluids to become a juice.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: HERACROSS
pokemon.pokedexEntry: They gather in forests seeking the sweet sap of trees. It is completely clad in a steel-hard shell. It is proud of its horn, which it uses to fling foes.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: SNEASEL
pokemon.pokedexEntry: A SNEASEL scales trees by punching its hooked claws into the bark. It seeks out unguarded nests and steals eggs for food while the parents are away.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: TEDDIURSA
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It licks its palms that are sweetened by being soaked in honey. A TEDDIURSA makes its own honey by blending fruits and pollen collected by BEEDRILL.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: URSARING
pokemon.pokedexEntry: In forests, it is said that there are many streams and towering trees where an URSARING gathers food. It walks through its forest collecting food every day.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: SLUGMA
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It is a species of POKéMON that lives in volcanic areas. If its body cools, its skin hardens and immobilizes it. To avoid that, it sleeps near magma.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: MAGCARGO
pokemon.pokedexEntry: The shell on its back is made of hardened magma. Tens of thousands of years spent living in volcanic craters have turned MAGCARGO's bodies into magma.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: SWINUB
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It roots for food by rubbing its snout against the ground. Its favorite food is a mushroom that grows under dried grass. It occasionally roots out hot springs.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: PILOSWINE
pokemon.pokedexEntry: A PILOSWINE is covered by a thick coat of long hair for enduring freezing cold. It uses its tusks to dig up food that has been buried under ice.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: CORSOLA
pokemon.pokedexEntry: CORSOLA live in warm southern seas. If the sea becomes polluted, the beautiful coral stalks become discolored and crumble away in tatters.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: REMORAID
pokemon.pokedexEntry: A REMORAID uses its abdominal muscles to forcefully expel swallowed water, then shoot down flying prey. When evolution approaches, it travels down rivers.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: OCTILLERY
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It ensnares its foe with its suction- cupped tentacles before delivering the finishing blow. If the foe turns out to be too strong, it spews ink to escape.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: DELIBIRD
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It carries food bundled up in its tail. There was a famous explorer who managed to scale Mt. Everest thanks to a DELIBIRD sharing its food.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: MANTINE
pokemon.pokedexEntry: On sunny days, schools of MANTINE can be seen elegantly leaping over the waves. It is not bothered by the REMORAID that hitches rides.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: SKARMORY
pokemon.pokedexEntry: A POKéMON that has a body and wings of steel. People in the past used feathers fallen from SKARMORY to make swords and knives.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: HOUNDOUR
pokemon.pokedexEntry: HOUNDOUR communicate with each other using a variety of cries to corner their prey. This POKéMON's remarkable teamwork is simply unparalleled.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: HOUNDOOM
pokemon.pokedexEntry: In a HOUNDOOM pack, the one with its horns raked sharply back serves a leadership role. They choose their leader by fighting among themselves.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: KINGDRA
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It sleeps quietly, deep on the seafloor. When it comes up to the surface, it creates a huge whirlpool that can swallow even ships.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: PHANPY
pokemon.pokedexEntry: PHANPY's big ears serve as broad fans. When it becomes hot, it flaps the ears busily to cool down. Even the young are very strong.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: DONPHAN
pokemon.pokedexEntry: A DONPHAN is so strong it can easily haul a dump truck. Its hide has toughened to a rock-hard state. An ordinary sort of attack won't even leave a scratch.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: PORYGON2
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It was created by humans using the power of science. It has been given artificial intelligence that enables it to learn new gestures and emotions on its own.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: STANTLER
pokemon.pokedexEntry: STANTLER's magnificent antlers were once traded at high prices as works of art. As a result, this POKéMON was hunted close to extinction.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: SMEARGLE
pokemon.pokedexEntry: A SMEARGLE marks its territory using a fluid that leaks out from the tip of its tail. About 5,000 different marks left by this POKéMON have been found.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: TYROGUE
pokemon.pokedexEntry: TYROGUE become stressed out if they do not get to train every day. When raising this POKéMON, the TRAINER must establish a regular training schedule.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: HITMONTOP
pokemon.pokedexEntry: Its technique of kicking while spinning is a remarkable mix of both offense and defense. HITMONTOP travel faster spinning than they do walking.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: SMOOCHUM
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It actively runs about, but also falls often. Whenever it falls, it will check its reflection on a lake's surface to make sure its face hasn't become dirty.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: ELEKID
pokemon.pokedexEntry: If it touches metal and discharges the electricity it has stored in its body, an ELEKID begins swinging its arms in circles to recharge itself.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: MAGBY
pokemon.pokedexEntry: If a MAGBY is spouting yellow flames from its mouth, it is in good health. When it is fatigued, black smoke will be mixed in with the flames.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: MILTANK
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It gives over five gallons of milk daily. Its sweet milk is enjoyed by children and grown-ups alike. People who can't drink milk turn it into yogurt and eat it instead.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: BLISSEY
pokemon.pokedexEntry: If it senses sadness with its fluffy fur, a BLISSEY will rush over to the sad person, however far away, to share an egg of happiness that brings a smile to any face.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: RAIKOU
pokemon.pokedexEntry: RAIKOU embodies the speed of lightning. Its roars send shock waves shuddering through the air and ground as if lightning bolts were crashing down.

pokemon.name: ENTEI

pokemon.name: SUICUNE
pokemon.pokedexEntry: SUICUNE embodies the compassion of a pure spring of water. It runs across the land with gliding elegance. It has the power to purify dirty water.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: LARVITAR
pokemon.pokedexEntry: A LARVITAR is born deep under the ground. It must eat its way through the soil above and reach the surface for it to see its parents' faces.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: PUPITAR
pokemon.pokedexEntry: A PUPITAR creates a gas inside its body that it ejects under compression to propel itself like a jet. Its body can withstand a collision with solid steel.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: TYRANITAR
pokemon.pokedexEntry: A TYRANITAR is so overwhelmingly powerful, it can bring down a whole mountain to make its nest. It roams in mountains seeking new opponents to fight.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: LUGIA
pokemon.pokedexEntry: LUGIA is so powerful even a light fluttering of its wings can blow apart houses. As a result, it chooses to live out of sight deep under the sea.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: HO-OH
pokemon.pokedexEntry: Its feathers--which glow in seven colors depending on the angle at which they are struck by light--are thought to bring joy. It is said to live at the foot of a rainbow.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: CELEBI
pokemon.pokedexEntry: This POKéMON came from the future by crossing over time. It is thought that so long as CELEBI appears, a bright and shining future awaits us.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: TREECKO
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It makes its nest in a giant tree in the forest. It ferociously guards against anything nearing its territory. It is said to be the protector of the forest's trees.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: GROVYLE
pokemon.pokedexEntry: Leaves grow out of this POKéMON's body. They help obscure a GROVYLE from the eyes of its enemies while it is in a thickly overgrown forest.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: SCEPTILE
pokemon.pokedexEntry: In the jungle, its power is without equal. This POKéMON carefully grows trees and plants. It regulates its body temperature by basking in sunlight.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: TORCHIC
pokemon.pokedexEntry: If attacked, it strikes back by spitting balls of fire it forms in its stomach. A TORCHIC dislikes darkness because it can't see its surroundings.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: COMBUSKEN
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It lashes out with 10 kicks per second. Its strong fighting instinct compels it to keep up its offensive until the opponent gives up.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: BLAZIKEN
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It learns martial arts that use punches and kicks. Every several years, its old feathers burn off, and new, supple feathers grow back in their place.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: MUDKIP
pokemon.pokedexEntry: On land, it can powerfully lift large boulders by planting its four feet and heaving. It sleeps by burying itself in soil at the water's edge.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: MARSHTOMP
pokemon.pokedexEntry: Its toughened hind legs enable it to stand upright. Because it weakens if its skin dries out, it replenishes fluids by playing in mud.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: SWAMPERT
pokemon.pokedexEntry: If it senses the approach of a storm and a tidal wave, it protects its seaside nest by piling up boulders. It swims as fast as a jet ski.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: POOCHYENA
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It savagely threatens foes with bared fangs. It chases after fleeing targets tenaciously. It turns tail and runs, however, if the foe strikes back.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: MIGHTYENA
pokemon.pokedexEntry: In the wild, MIGHTYENA live in a pack. They never defy their leader's orders. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: ZIGZAGOON
pokemon.pokedexEntry: Rubbing its nose against the ground, it always wanders about back and forth in search of something. It is distinguished by the zigzag footprints it leaves.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: LINOONE
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It is exceedingly fast if it only has to run in a straight line. When it spots pond- dwelling prey underwater, it quickly leaps in and catches it with its sharp claws.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: WURMPLE
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It sticks to tree branches and eats leaves. The thread it spits from its mouth, which becomes gooey when it touches air, slows the movement of its foes.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: SILCOON
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It prepares for evolution using the energy it stored while it was a WURMPLE. It keeps watch over the surroundings with its two eyes.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: BEAUTIFLY
pokemon.pokedexEntry: Its colorfully patterned wings are its most prominent feature. It flies through flower-covered fields collecting pollen. It attacks ferociously when angered.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: CASCOON
pokemon.pokedexEntry: To avoid detection by its enemies, it hides motionlessly beneath large leaves and in the gaps of branches. It also attaches dead leaves to its body for camouflage.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: DUSTOX
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It is a nocturnal POKéMON that flies from fields and mountains to the attraction of streetlights at night. It looses highly toxic powder from its wings.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: LOTAD
pokemon.pokedexEntry: This POKéMON lives in ponds with clean water. It is known to ferry small POKéMON across ponds by carrying them on the broad leaf on its head.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: LOMBRE
pokemon.pokedexEntry: In the evening, it takes great delight in popping out of rivers and startling people. It feeds on aquatic moss that grows on rocks in the riverbed.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: LUDICOLO
pokemon.pokedexEntry: When it hears festive music, all the cells in its body become stimulated, and it begins moving in rhythm. It does not quail even when it faces a tough opponent.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: SEEDOT
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It hangs off branches and absorbs nutrients. When it finishes eating, its body becomes so heavy that it drops to the ground with a thump.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: NUZLEAF
pokemon.pokedexEntry: A forest-dwelling POKéMON that is skilled at climbing trees. Its long and pointed nose is its weak point. It loses power if the nose is gripped.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: SHIFTRY
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It is said to arrive on chilly, wintry winds. Feared from long ago as the guardian of forests, this POKéMON lives in a deep forest where people do not venture.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: NINCADA
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It makes its nest at the roots of a mighty tree. Using its whiskerlike antennae, it probes its surroundings in the pitch-black darkness of soil.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: NINJASK
pokemon.pokedexEntry: Because it darts about vigorously at high speed, it is very difficult to see. Hearing its distinctive cries for too long induces a headache.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: SHEDINJA
pokemon.pokedexEntry: A peculiar POKéMON that floats in air even though its wings remain completely still. The inside of its body is hollow and utterly dark.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: TAILLOW
pokemon.pokedexEntry: Although it is small, it is very courageous. It will take on a larger SKARMORY on an equal footing. However, its will weakens if it becomes hungry.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: SWELLOW
pokemon.pokedexEntry: A SWELLOW dives upon prey from far above. It never misses its targets. It takes to the skies in search of lands with a warm climate.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: SHROOMISH
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It loves to eat damp, composted soil in forests. If you enter a forest after a long rain, you can see many SHROOMISH feasting on composted soil.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: BRELOOM
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It scatters spores from holes in the cap on its head. It loves warm and humid climates. It feeds on trees and plants in fields and forests.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: SPINDA
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It is distinguished by a pattern of spots that is always different. Its unsteady, tottering walk has the effect of fouling its foe's aim.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: WINGULL
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It makes its nest on a sheer cliff at the edge of the sea. It has trouble keeping its wings flapping in flight. Instead, it soars on updrafts.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: PELIPPER
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It skims the tops of waves as it flies. When it spots prey, it uses its large beak to scoop up the victim with water. It protects its eggs in its beak.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: SURSKIT
pokemon.pokedexEntry: They gather on puddles after evening downpours, gliding across the surface of water as if sliding. It secretes honey with a sweet aroma from its head.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: MASQUERAIN
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It intimidates foes with the large eyelike patterns on its antennae. Because it can't fly if its wings get wet, it shelters itself from rain under large trees and eaves.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: WAILMER
pokemon.pokedexEntry: While this POKéMON usually lives in the sea, it can survive on land, although not too long. It loses vitality if its body becomes dried out.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: WAILORD
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It breathes through nostrils that it raises above the sea. By inhaling to its maximum capacity, a WAILORD can dive close to 10,000 feet beneath the waves.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: SKITTY
pokemon.pokedexEntry: A SKITTY's adorably cute behavior makes it highly popular. In battle, it makes its tail puff out. It threatens foes with a sharp growl.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: DELCATTY
pokemon.pokedexEntry: Rather than keeping a permanent lair, it habitually seeks comfortable spots and sleeps there. It is nocturnal and becomes active at dusk.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: KECLEON
pokemon.pokedexEntry: A POKéMON that has the ability to alter its body colors to match its surroundings. A KECLEON reverts to its original colors if it is startled.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: BALTOY
pokemon.pokedexEntry: A BALTOY moves by spinning on its single foot. It has been depicted in murals adorning the walls of a once-bustling city in an ancient age.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: CLAYDOL
pokemon.pokedexEntry: A CLAYDOL sleeps while hovering in midair. Its arms are separate from its body. They are kept floating by the POKéMON's manipulation of psychic power.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: NOSEPASS
pokemon.pokedexEntry: Its body emits a powerful magnetism. It feeds on prey that is pulled in by the force. Its magnetism is stronger in cold seasons.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: TORKOAL
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It battles using energy it gets from burning coal. When loosing smoke from its nostrils, it lets off a sound that is similar to a locomotive's horn.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: SABLEYE
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It digs branching holes in caves using its sharp claws in search of food--raw gems. A SABLEYE lurks in darkness and is seen only rarely.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: BARBOACH
pokemon.pokedexEntry: Its body is covered with a slimy film. The film acts as a barrier to prevent germs in muddy water from entering the BARBOACH's body.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: WHISCASH
pokemon.pokedexEntry: Mysteriously, it can foretell earthquakes. In the daytime, it sleeps in mud at the bottom of a pond. When it awakens, it continually feeds throughout the night.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: LUVDISC
pokemon.pokedexEntry: LUVDISC make the branches of CORSOLA their nests. There is a custom from long ago of giving a LUVDISC as a gift to express one's feelings of love.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: CORPHISH
pokemon.pokedexEntry: Once it grips prey with its large pincers, it will never let go, no matter what. It is a hardy POKéMON that can thrive in any environment.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: CRAWDAUNT
pokemon.pokedexEntry: A brutish POKéMON that loves to battle. A veteran CRAWDAUNT that has prevailed in hundreds of battles has giant pincers marked with countless scars.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: FEEBAS
pokemon.pokedexEntry: FEEBAS live in ponds that are heavily infested with weeds. Because of its hopelessly shabby appearance, it seems as if few TRAINERS raise it.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: MILOTIC
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It is said to live at the bottom of large lakes. Considered to be the most beautiful of all POKéMON, it has been depicted in paintings and statues.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: CARVANHA
pokemon.pokedexEntry: CARVANHA attack ships in swarms, making them sink. Although it is said to be a very vicious POKéMON, it timidly flees as soon as it finds itself alone.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: SHARPEDO
pokemon.pokedexEntry: The vicious and sly gangster of the sea. Its skin is specially textured to minimize drag in water. Its speed tops out at over 75 miles per hour.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: TRAPINCH
pokemon.pokedexEntry: Its big jaws crunch through boulders. Because its head is so big, it has a hard time getting back upright if it tips over onto its back.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: VIBRAVA
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It looses ultrasonic waves by rubbing its wings together. Since a VIBRAVA's wings are still in the process of growing, it can only fly short distances.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: FLYGON
pokemon.pokedexEntry: The flapping of its wings sounds like singing. To prevent detection by enemies, it hides itself by flapping up a cloud of desert sand.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: MAKUHITA
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It loves to toughen up its body above all else. If you hear quaking rumbles in a cave, it is the sound of MAKUHITA undertaking strenuous training.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: HARIYAMA
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It has the habit of challenging others without hesitation to tests of strength. It's been known to stand on train tracks and stop trains using forearm thrusts.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: ELECTRIKE
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It generates electricity using friction from the atmosphere. In seasons with especially arid air, its entire body blazes with violent showers of sparks.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: MANECTRIC
pokemon.pokedexEntry: Because lightning falls in their vicinities, MANECTRIC were thought to have been born from lightning. In battle, they create thunderclouds.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: NUMEL
pokemon.pokedexEntry: A NUMEL stores boiling magma in the hump on its back. It is a hardy POKéMON that can transport a 220-pound load. It has served humans at work since long ago.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: CAMERUPT
pokemon.pokedexEntry: A POKéMON that lives in the crater of a volcano. Every 10 years, the volcanoes on its back erupt violently. Research is under way on the cause of eruption.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: SPHEAL
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It is completely covered with plushy fur. As a result, it never feels the cold even when it is rolling about on ice floes or diving in the sea.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: SEALEO
pokemon.pokedexEntry: SEALEO live in herds on ice floes. Using its powerful flippers, it shatters ice. It dives into the sea to hunt prey five times a day.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: WALREIN
pokemon.pokedexEntry: To protect its herd, the leader battles anything that invades its territory, even at the cost of its life. Its tusks may snap off in battle.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: CACNEA
pokemon.pokedexEntry: CACNEA live in deserts with virtually no rainfall. It battles by swinging its thick, spiked arms. Once a year, a yellow flower blooms.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: CACTURNE
pokemon.pokedexEntry: After spending thousands of years in harsh deserts, its blood transformed into the same substances as sand. It is nocturnal, so it hunts at night.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: SNORUNT
pokemon.pokedexEntry: They tend to move about in groups of around five SNORUNT. In snowy regions, it is said that when they are seen late at night, snowfall will arrive by morning.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: GLALIE
pokemon.pokedexEntry: A GLALIE has the power to instantaneously freeze moisture in the atmosphere. A dazzling cloud of diamondlike ice crystals forms around its body.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: LUNATONE
pokemon.pokedexEntry: It becomes very active on the night of a full moon. This POKéMON was first discovered 40 years ago at the site of a meteor strike.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: SOLROCK
pokemon.pokedexEntry: Solar energy is the source of this POKéMON's power. On sunny days, groups of SOLROCK line up facing the sun and absorb its light.

pokedexMemory.note: struct Pokedex lives inside SaveBlock2 at offset 0x18. owned[]/seen[] are bit arrays indexed by (nationalDexNumber-1).

pokemon.name: AZURILL
pokemon.pokedexEntry: Its tail, which is packed with nutrition, is very bouncy like a rubber ball. On sunny days they gather at the edge of water and splash about for fun.
